name: ztensor
description: Anonymous voting and consensus for miner/validator networks. Members cast LSAG ring-signed votes: the tally proves a member of the eligible set voted without revealing which one; a per-topic key image blocks double-voting. Private ballots, public books: votes are unlinkable, reward payouts are transparent and auditable. Rust (axum) API serving a static Next.js console; keygen and signing run client-side so secrets never reach the service.

register.docs: {pub} -> {index, size}; add a PUBLIC key (hex) to the eligible set — secret keys never reach the service

set.docs: -> {size, participants}; the current eligible set of public keys

ring.docs: {topic} -> {ring, frozen, size}; the ring a vote on this topic must be signed against (frozen at the topic's first vote)

vote.docs: {topic, choice, sig} -> {accepted}; cast an anonymous LSAG-signed vote; the key-image tag prevents double-voting per topic

tally.docs: {topic} -> {counts, total}; public tally of anonymous votes

payout.docs: {topic, pool} -> {instructions}; transparent reward instructions derived from the tally (public and linkable by design)

topics.docs: -> {topics}; every topic with its ring size and vote count
